- **The hours are not dated for the visit.** 
The museum's own page lists 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Tuesday to Sunday.
 That is its current schedule, not hours posted for August 30 to September 2. Going by that schedule, Mondays are closed, so a Monday visit day would need a different plan.
- **Price is left out.** The only prices I found were on a third-party listing, not the museum's own page.
- **Canadian Children's Museum, Gatineau (left out).** It is a strong fit for this age. 
It sits inside the Canadian Museum of History, and general admission covers both.
 But the hours its own page posts are 
Sept. 8 to Dec. 9, 2026
. That season starts after the visit window, so I can't say it is open on those days.
- **Canadian Museum of Nature (left out).** Its own page shows only the current day's hours and nothing for your dates. I found no age information on its own pages either.
- **Not covered.** I ran out of searches before checking zoos, aquariums and playgrounds, so there are no picks for those.
